description: CRA capital cost allowance on a business or rental asset: class rate, year-1 CCA (half-year rule, AIIP or the post-2024 accelerated incentive, by acquisition date), tax saving at your marginal rate, a 5-year schedule, and recapture or terminal loss on disposal.

acquisitionDate.description: Date acquired, YYYY-MM-DD; omitted = half-year rule

annualIncome.description: Taxable income before CCA, for the marginal rate

assetCost.description: Capital cost of the asset in CAD

ccaClass.description: CCA class id (e.g. class8, class50), used when assetPreset='custom'

disposalProceeds.description: Proceeds if the asset is sold, for recapture or terminal loss

existingUCC.description: Undepreciated capital cost already in the class; 0 for a new purchase

netRentalIncomeBeforeCCA.description: Rental building only: net rental income before CCA (CCA can't create a rental loss)

province.description: Province/territory code for the marginal tax rate, e.g. ON

name: capital_cost_allowance
title: Capital Cost Allowance (CCA) Calculator
